title: High-Order Multi-Scale Method and Its Convergence Analysis for Nonlinear Thermo-Electro-Mechanical Coupling Problems of Composite Structures
summary: This study proposes a high-order multi-scale method tailored for time-dependent nonlinear thermo-electro-mechanical coupling problems of composite structures with highly spatial heterogeneity, which incorporate temperature-dependent material properties and Joule heating effect. By employing the multi-scale asymptotic approach and the Taylor series technique, a high-accuracy multi-scale asymptotic model featuring novel high-order correction terms is established for nonlinear multi-physics simulation of periodic solid structures.
